title: Product morning clipboard
content:
07:30 quick capture before standup
- brain dump of open things, will triage after standup

Top priorities today (priority order)
1) PRD edits: finalize acceptance criteria for streaming fallback + error handling. note: need precise SLO wording (latency bounds under degraded throughput).
2) Stakeholder follow-ups: infra quota + legal DPA redline + design signoff on empty-state UX.
3) Launch checklist items: smoke env verification, canary rollout gating, dashboard alerts ready.

PRD edit checklist (sections to update)
- summary: tighten language on "fallback model variants" (avoid implying guaranteed quality) — suggested phrasing: "automatic fallback to compatible model variants based on routing policy; clients should validate outputs when model variant changes."
- acceptance criteria: add test cases for prefix cache correctness when switching model variants
- monitoring: call out exact metrics to ship (per-route p50/p95 latency, token cost per route, model fallback rate)
- rollout plan: add explicit rollback triggers (error rate > 2% for 5m, fallback rate > 10% for 10m)
- docs: add snippet for SDK usage showing streaming + tool-calls example (small code block)

Notes-to-self for PRD wording:
- avoid "always" and "guarantee" language
- include a short example scenario: heavy-seq billing-sensitive customer uses cheaper quantized model variant during spikes
- link to eval harness in linked artifacts section

Stakeholder follow-ups (who / ask / deadline)
- Daniel (infra): confirm Dedicated quota availability for region-us-west-2 by EOD; ask about preemptible vs reserved mix for canary.
- Maya (legal): DPA redline summary — need one-pager on customer data handling claims (due tomorrow COB)
- Jonas (design): quick mock of empty state / error modal for streaming fallback (can we fit into tomorrow's design sprint?)
- Ops (oncall): prepare runbook snippet for model fallback incident (where to toggle fallback, how to escalate)

Launch checklist (quick items - I will check off)
[ ] smoke test: hosted-api/staging - basic generate + embeddings (runbook: smoke/generate-staging.md)
[ ] dashboard: token-cost per-route panel created in Grafana (owner: metrics-team)
[ ] canary: configure 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% gating steps in rollout config
[ ] alerts: paging rule for error rate and fallback rate (severity: P1 for >5% errors)
[ ] docs: one-pager for customers about "fallback behavior" (customer-success review)
[ ] SDK snippet: add streaming example to quickstart (owner: devexp)

Risks / open blockers
- infra quota delays -> push canary later (contingency: use hosted warm pool; question: cost tolerance?)
- legal redline could require private deployment option in contract (impact on sales cycle)
- unclear SLA language may confuse customers about "best-effort" model fallback

Quick meeting notes (standup capture)
- Infra: Daniel -> working on quota request, ETA today afternoon
- SRE: investigating transient KV cache miss pattern at sequence lengths > 4k; might affect latency SLO in worst-case. follow-up with SRE on mitigation plan (prefer opt-out flag in runtime)
- Devexp: will add SDK snippet, target PR by EOD

Timeboxes for today
- 08:30-09:00 triage PRD edits + push a PR to confluence + ping legal
- 09:00-10:00 unblock infra / quota conversation (meeting with Daniel if needed)
- 11:00-12:00 design sync (Jonas) + quick mock review
- 13:00-14:30 writing customer one-pager + checklist for CS
- 15:00-16:00 run smoke tests with ops + open bug triage

Open questions (need answers today)
- what is the exact billing delta when switching to quantized model variant per 1k tokens? (ask pricing analytics)
- can we get a non-prod dedicated pool for one-day canary testing? (infra)
- are there legal must-haves for data residency in the standard DPA template? (legal)

Random quick notes / friction items
- SDK streaming example should intentionally show how to handle partial outputs (important for tool-calls)
- suggest adding a "fallback_reason" field to audit logs for customer-facing troubleshooting
- telemetry: record model_variant + fallback_trigger in token-level traces for postmortems

Done for now — will trim and move cleaned items into the PRD and Confluence page after lunch.

— Asha
